description: This file defines CLI commands for browser environment configuration, including viewport size, offline mode, headers, credentials, geolocation, media preferences, timezone, locale, and device emulation. It imports external modules for command handling and runtime operations, and exports a function to register these commands.

methods.name: parseOnOff
methods.description: Parses a string ('on'/'off') into a boolean or null.

methods.name: runBrowserCommand
methods.description: Executes a command with runtime error handling.

methods.name: runBrowserSetRequest
methods.description: Performs a browser request with error handling and optional JSON output.
